articles.title: At the Detroit Institute of Arts, the Riches of African-American Art
articles.mainIdea: At the Detroit Institute of Arts, the Riches of African-American Art
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: At the Detroit Institute of Arts, the Riches of African-American Art. The museum, which has long collected works by black artists, rehangs some of its galleries to offer a fascinating journey through a wondrous, complex tradition.
